_howToEdit: This file is the referral list. Edit it here — no developer needed, no rebuild.
Add one object per provider inside the "providers" array below, copying "_template".
The page groups providers automatically by whatever you type in "discipline".
1. Look them up in the NYSED Office of the Professions license verification tool.
2. Put the license number in "license" and today's date in "licenseCheckedOn".
3. Re-check every listed provider every 6 months and update "licenseCheckedOn".
A listed provider whose license has lapsed becomes our problem, not theirs.
NEVER: take or offer money, a fee, or a reciprocal arrangement for any listing.
NEVER: write "recommended", "vetted", "approved", or "trusted" anywhere in here.
ALWAYS: remove anyone who asks, within a week, no questions.
"insurance" and "rsa" matter most to a parent. Cost and paperwork are what actually
stop families — not a shortage of names. Fill those two in even when they are ugly.
Leave a field as an empty string if you don't know it yet. The page hides blanks
